meta.scope: M3.5 Hanzi set (owner decision 2026-11-27, scope migration): the 246 HSK 3.0 Level 1 recognition characters (set 'syllabus-l1', active) plus 40 retained earlier-selection characters (set 'extension', archive, no HSK level claimed). Personal-use-first. Total records 286 unique simplified characters (not words).
meta.selectionNote: Active set = HSK 3.0 Level 1 recognition characters (246) in exact source order (field sourceOrder 1..246), taken from the owner-supplied transcription of the official syllabus. The 40 'extension' records come from the earlier original beginner selection; they are NOT in that list and carry no HSK level. Per-character level is not stored; membership is the set field only.
meta.contentOrigin: Vietnamese meanings, example words and art briefs are original text written for this project. No third-party dictionary data copied.
meta.artworkStyle: Premium editorial digital painting / gouache, 4:3 (1600x1200 webp), detailed natural textures, depth, soft directional lighting, coherent muted palette; no text or characters inside the artwork.
meta.artworkStatusNote: Artwork status in this file stays 'pending-artwork' until the owner records approval here. The owner reports 10 pilot candidate images in the generation artifact ledger; this repository does not contain or verify them. The brief is a modern memory aid, never historical evidence.
meta.historyNote: No historical forms are claimed here; history lives in the sourced history manifest only.
meta.thumbnailGuidance: Applied to every character not marked promptVersion v1 (the owner-accepted pilot images keep the frozen v1 prompt so their hashes stay valid): dominant subject >= half of frame height, simple silhouette, strong value contrast, subordinate calm background, legible at ~160 px.

hsk3L1Source.provenance: Owner-supplied transcription (extracted by GPT with pdftotext -layout from the owner-uploaded PDF). This project did NOT download or independently verify the PDF.
